title: Issue with Selector rendering
body:
On Firefox 41.0.2, I get this weird issue on a value selection where it displays: 
- The selected option
- The first option for a fraction of a sec
- The selected option back again

![selector bug](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/5095856/10756357/d62e3f00-7ca3-11e5-9eae-a754f518dcc6.gif)

It seems like `render` is only called once, but I believe the issue might be caused by the replacement of the select in the DOM.
